## The Scalable Standard For Commercial Embroidery

## We help the world’s most iconic brands AND next generation of entrepreneurs trade operational
## friction for freedom and financial success.

[Get Your Growth Roadmap][41]

## Your Business – Our Solution

[Melco embroidery machines with customer]

### Start Your Business

Do you want to turn your hobby into a business? We’re here to help! Melco has a dedicated support
team, training included with your machine purchase, and financing options.

[Get Started Today][42]

### Grow Your Business

Are you an industrial embroiderer? Are you ready to expand your business? Check out the features and
benefits of our modular multi-head system with the EMT16X and SUMMIT.

[Learn More][43]

## Melco Keys To Success

### **Maximum Flexibility**

Our modular single and multi-head embroidery machines allow you to produce up to 100% more
efficiently and up to 50% cheaper.

### **Premium Quality**

Thanks to Acti-Feed™, you can embroider small letters with pin-sharp definition and also embroider
special effects and special threads in the best quality.

### **Rapid Production**

Dramatically increase your productivity thanks to an embroidery speed of up to 1500 stitches per
minute on Melco embroidery machines.

### **Simple Operation**

From barcoded design and hoop loading to laser assisted design registration, every step of the
embroidery process has been optimized to reduce hassle and save you valuable time.

[Learn About Melco’s Intelligent Embroidery System][44]

## Innovative Software
* [Melco Fusion][45]
* [Melco EFS][46]
* [Melco Calculator][47]
* [DesignShop 12][48]

[Melco Fusion]

Melco Fusion is a cloud-based web service hosted by Melco that generates product previews and
embroidery-ready files using data submitted by users on your e-commerce website. Save time and money
when you let Fusion do the heavy lifting of design layout and digitizing. Eliminate order errors and
increase customer satisfaction with the powerful dynamic product preview. Automate ordering from
your e-commerce store with Melco Fusion!

[More about Melco Fusion][49]
[Melco EFS ]

Melco EFS stands for Enterprise Fulfillment Solution. This automated pipeline enables you to produce
large numbers of individualized items. Streamline your production process by creating embroidery
production files directly from customer data. Best of all, there is no integration necessary with
Melco EFS. This easy-to-use solution will save you time and money with automatic pattern creation,
reduced errors and increased customer satisfaction.

[More About Melco EFS][50]
[Melco calculator]

Quickly calculate production times & costs with our Melco Calculator. This calculator is free, fast,
and easy! Simply upload an embroidery design, enter parameters and you’re done! This will help you
calculate optimal machine setup, production time, job cost and machine ROI. Optimize your business
today!

[More About Melco Calculator][51]
[DesignShop 12 Embroidery Software]

With DesignShop 12, we’ve made profound improvements to every aspect of the digitizing experience.
Accelerate digitizing with features such as Design Checker, Conversion Assistant and Enhanced
Lettering. Organize production with design barcoding. Plus, get plug and play productivity with a
huge library of premade designs, fonts and monograms. With four different levels, purchase the level
that best fits your business needs.

[More About DesignShop 12][52]

## Digital Printing

### Epson

Epson is the industry leader in direct-to-garment printing for small businesses. These fast, compact
printers are user-friendly too!  **[Learn more about EPSON direct-to-garment printing][53]**.

## Roland

From vehicle wraps to promotional stickers, Roland large format printers/cutters can allow you to
provide new products to your customers.  [**Learn more about Roland large format printers**.][54]

## The Scalable Standard For Commercial Embroidery

## We help the world’s most iconic brands AND next generation of entrepreneurs trade operational
## friction for freedom and financial success.

[Get Your Growth Roadmap][41]

## Your Business – Our Solution

[Melco embroidery machines with customer]

### Start Your Business

Do you want to turn your hobby into a business? We’re here to help! Melco has a dedicated support
team, training included with your machine purchase, and financing options.

[Get Started Today][42]

### Grow Your Business

Are you an industrial embroiderer? Are you ready to expand your business? Check out the features and
benefits of our modular multi-head system with the EMT16X and SUMMIT.

[Learn More][43]

## Melco Keys To Success

### **Maximum Flexibility**

Our modular single and multi-head embroidery machines allow you to produce up to 100% more
efficiently and up to 50% cheaper.

### **Premium Quality**

Thanks to Acti-Feed™, you can embroider small letters with pin-sharp definition and also embroider
special effects and special threads in the best quality.

### **Rapid Production**

Dramatically increase your productivity thanks to an embroidery speed of up to 1500 stitches per
minute on Melco embroidery machines.

### **Simple Operation**

From barcoded design and hoop loading to laser assisted design registration, every step of the
embroidery process has been optimized to reduce hassle and save you valuable time.

[Learn About Melco’s Intelligent Embroidery System][44]

## Innovative Software
* [Melco Fusion][45]
* [Melco EFS][46]
* [Melco Calculator][47]
* [DesignShop 12][48]

[Melco Fusion]

Melco Fusion is a cloud-based web service hosted by Melco that generates product previews and
embroidery-ready files using data submitted by users on your e-commerce website. Save time and money
when you let Fusion do the heavy lifting of design layout and digitizing. Eliminate order errors and
increase customer satisfaction with the powerful dynamic product preview. Automate ordering from
your e-commerce store with Melco Fusion!

[More about Melco Fusion][49]
[Melco EFS ]

Melco EFS stands for Enterprise Fulfillment Solution. This automated pipeline enables you to produce
large numbers of individualized items. Streamline your production process by creating embroidery
production files directly from customer data. Best of all, there is no integration necessary with
Melco EFS. This easy-to-use solution will save you time and money with automatic pattern creation,
reduced errors and increased customer satisfaction.

[More About Melco EFS][50]
[Melco calculator]

Quickly calculate production times & costs with our Melco Calculator. This calculator is free, fast,
and easy! Simply upload an embroidery design, enter parameters and you’re done! This will help you
calculate optimal machine setup, production time, job cost and machine ROI. Optimize your business
today!

[More About Melco Calculator][51]
[DesignShop 12 Embroidery Software]

With DesignShop 12, we’ve made profound improvements to every aspect of the digitizing experience.
Accelerate digitizing with features such as Design Checker, Conversion Assistant and Enhanced
Lettering. Organize production with design barcoding. Plus, get plug and play productivity with a
huge library of premade designs, fonts and monograms. With four different levels, purchase the level
that best fits your business needs.

[More About DesignShop 12][52]

## Digital Printing

### Epson

Epson is the industry leader in direct-to-garment printing for small businesses. These fast, compact
printers are user-friendly too!  **[Learn more about EPSON direct-to-garment printing][53]**.

## Roland

From vehicle wraps to promotional stickers, Roland large format printers/cutters can allow you to
provide new products to your customers.  [**Learn more about Roland large format printers**.][54]

## About Melco

At Melco, we know that investing in equipment is just the first step in building a successful
business. That’s why we offer world-class training and support to help you achieve sustained
success. As the industry leader in apparel decoration solutions, we’ve been empowering entrepreneurs
with reliable and effective equipment and software solutions for over five decades.

We believe that our customers are more than just clients – they are our partners. We are committed
to fostering a collaborative relationship with our customers, no matter the size of their business
aspirations. We understand that their success is our success, and we are dedicated to providing them
with the best tools and support to achieve their goals.

# Visit Our Sewing Machine Warehouse in Houston, TX

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Who is Sewing and Vacuum Warehouse and where are you located?

A full‑service retail and online store for sewing, quilting, embroidery, longarm, and vacuums with
two locations:
• [13233 N Eldridge Pkwy, Cypress, TX 77429][116]
• [2018 I‑45 North, Suite B, Conroe, TX 77301][117]
Hours: Mon–Fri 10–6, Sat 10–5. Phone: (888) 857‑1746.

### Do you service and repair machines?

Yes—Service & Repairs include in‑store service and a virtual check‑in for machine service.

### 
### What products and brands do you carry?

Sewing/quilting machines, sergers/coverstitch, embroidery (single‑ and multi‑needle), longarm
machines/frames/accessories, sewing furniture, notions/supplies, cutting/printing tools, software,
vacuums, and pre‑owned machines. Featured brands include [Janome][118], [Juki][119], and
[Brother][120] (see Shop By Brand for the full list).

### 
### Do you offer classes and repair services?

Yes. Classes include [sewing/serging][121], [quilting][122], [embroidery][123], [longarm][124],
[ScanNCut][125], [bag making][126], [paper piecing][127], and software, plus virtual events. Full
in‑store service and repairs are available, with online virtual check‑in for machine service.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Who is Sewing and Vacuum Warehouse and where are you located?

A full‑service retail and online store for sewing, quilting, embroidery, longarm, and vacuums with
two locations:
• [13233 N Eldridge Pkwy, Cypress, TX 77429][116]
• [2018 I‑45 North, Suite B, Conroe, TX 77301][117]
Hours: Mon–Fri 10–6, Sat 10–5. Phone: (888) 857‑1746.

### Do you service and repair machines?

Yes—Service & Repairs include in‑store service and a virtual check‑in for machine service.

### 
### What products and brands do you carry?

Sewing/quilting machines, sergers/coverstitch, embroidery (single‑ and multi‑needle), longarm
machines/frames/accessories, sewing furniture, notions/supplies, cutting/printing tools, software,
vacuums, and pre‑owned machines. Featured brands include [Janome][118], [Juki][119], and
[Brother][120] (see Shop By Brand for the full list).

### 
### Do you offer classes and repair services?

Yes. Classes include [sewing/serging][121], [quilting][122], [embroidery][123], [longarm][124],
[ScanNCut][125], [bag making][126], [paper piecing][127], and software, plus virtual events. Full
in‑store service and repairs are available, with online virtual check‑in for machine service.

SPRINT

Flexibel einsetzbare Einkopf-Stickmaschinen

Die SPRINT 6, SPRINT 7 und SPRINT 8 sind die bis jetzt erfolgreichsten Modelle unserer populären
Einkopf-Stickmaschinen aus der Serie SPRINT. Die Maschinen bieten alle Betriebsarten wie Flachstick,
Kappe und Freiarm.

[Mehr erfahren][74]

[Sprint]

[Mehr erfahren][75]

RACER

Willkommen in der Zukunft der Produktivität

Mit den Stickmaschinen der neuen Baureihe RACER setzen wir den Weltstandard für Freiarm
Stickmaschinen. Entwickelt und gefertigt in Deutschland, garantiert dieses Maschinenkonzept kürzeste
Amortisationszeiten durch höchste Stickgeschwindigkeit.

[Mehr erfahren][76]

[Racer]

[Mehr erfahren][77]

Challenger

Zuverlässige Stickmaschinen Made in Germany

Egal, ob Ihr Schwerpunkt im Bereich der Flächen- oder Konfektionsstickerei liegt – unsere
Flachbettstickmaschinen sind das ideale Produktionsmittel, mit dem Sie selbst die höchsten
Qualitätsansprüche Ihrer Kunden erfüllen können.

[Mehr erfahren][78]

[Challenger]

[Mehr erfahren][79]

[Qualität Made in Germany]

### Qualität
### Made in Germany

Die ganze Welt der ZSK Produkte

ZSK Produkte bieten Qualität Made in Germany. Sie überzeugen mit solider Technik und durchdachten
Lösungen. Entdecken Sie ein breites Sortiment, das für verschiedene Ansprüche entwickelt wurde.

[Mehr erfahren][80]

[Software von ZSK STICKMASCHINEN für Ihre Stickdesigns]

Software

Schöpfen Sie das volle Potenzial Ihrer Stickmaschine aus?

Leistungsfähige Hardware bedingt leistungsfähige Software, um das volle Potenzial der
Maschinentechnologie auszuschöpfen. Die Software der ZSK ermöglichen eine fortschrittlichere
Kommunikation zwischen Ihnen und ihren ZSK Stickmaschinen.

[Mehr erfahren][81]
[Workflow Solutions]

Workflow Solutions

Willkommen in der Zukunft der Produktivität

ZSK Stickmaschinen sind auf dem neusten Stand der Technik, effizient und lassen sich einfach in
automatisierte Workflow-Lösungen integrieren.

[Mehr erfahren][82]
[Technische Stickerei]

Technische Stickerei

Höchstmaß an Automatisierung und Effizienz

Mit viel Know-how und Erfahrung im Textilmaschinenbau haben wir die ZSK Technischen Sticksysteme
entwickelt.

[Mehr erfahren][83]
[Smart Textiles]

Smart Textiles

E-Textilien - traditionelle Stoffe mit Funktion

Textiler Sensoren, Aktoren, Elektroden, funktionalen LED‘s- oder RFID-Pailletten, und selbst ganze
Leiterplatten (PCBs) mit leitfähigen Fäden lassen sich automatisch und zuverlässig integrieren.

[Mehr erfahren][84]

EPS - Das Easy Positioning System

Heizpresse!

SPRINT

Flexibel einsetzbare Einkopf-Stickmaschinen

Die SPRINT 6, SPRINT 7 und SPRINT 8 sind die bis jetzt erfolgreichsten Modelle unserer populären
Einkopf-Stickmaschinen aus der Serie SPRINT. Die Maschinen bieten alle Betriebsarten wie Flachstick,
Kappe und Freiarm.

[Mehr erfahren][74]

[Sprint]

[Mehr erfahren][75]

RACER

Willkommen in der Zukunft der Produktivität

Mit den Stickmaschinen der neuen Baureihe RACER setzen wir den Weltstandard für Freiarm
Stickmaschinen. Entwickelt und gefertigt in Deutschland, garantiert dieses Maschinenkonzept kürzeste
Amortisationszeiten durch höchste Stickgeschwindigkeit.

[Mehr erfahren][76]

[Racer]

[Mehr erfahren][77]

Challenger

Zuverlässige Stickmaschinen Made in Germany

Egal, ob Ihr Schwerpunkt im Bereich der Flächen- oder Konfektionsstickerei liegt – unsere
Flachbettstickmaschinen sind das ideale Produktionsmittel, mit dem Sie selbst die höchsten
Qualitätsansprüche Ihrer Kunden erfüllen können.

[Mehr erfahren][78]

### Made in Germany

Die ganze Welt der ZSK Produkte

ZSK Produkte bieten Qualität Made in Germany. Sie überzeugen mit solider Technik und durchdachten
Lösungen. Entdecken Sie ein breites Sortiment, das für verschiedene Ansprüche entwickelt wurde.

[Mehr erfahren][80]

[Software von ZSK STICKMASCHINEN für Ihre Stickdesigns]

Software

Schöpfen Sie das volle Potenzial Ihrer Stickmaschine aus?

Leistungsfähige Hardware bedingt leistungsfähige Software, um das volle Potenzial der
Maschinentechnologie auszuschöpfen. Die Software der ZSK ermöglichen eine fortschrittlichere
Kommunikation zwischen Ihnen und ihren ZSK Stickmaschinen.

[Mehr erfahren][81]

Workflow Solutions

Willkommen in der Zukunft der Produktivität

ZSK Stickmaschinen sind auf dem neusten Stand der Technik, effizient und lassen sich einfach in
automatisierte Workflow-Lösungen integrieren.

[Mehr erfahren][82]

Technische Stickerei

Höchstmaß an Automatisierung und Effizienz

Mit viel Know-how und Erfahrung im Textilmaschinenbau haben wir die ZSK Technischen Sticksysteme
entwickelt.

Smart Textiles

E-Textilien - traditionelle Stoffe mit Funktion

Leiterplatten (PCBs) mit leitfähigen Fäden lassen sich automatisch und zuverlässig integrieren.

** [ [Fashion Apparel Search Trendy Pants]][14]**We provide members of the apparel industry with
excellent resources that aid with efficiently & effectively completing daily business tasks. Viewers
of our website are presented with easily accessible information about all garment categories,
fabric, trim & notions, services, and other relevant topics of interest.

Educate yourself about fabrics, clothing design, merchandising, manufacturing, distribution, retail
and more.

Apparel Search is one of the largest online guides to the fashion industry.

For those of you searching for clothes, shoes, accessories or educational resources, Apparel Search
presents research tools, statistical analysis, seminars & training opportunities, as well as a
detailed list of fashion schools around the world.  You can find research regarding various
components of the international *business of fashion*.

**Research more about the fashion industry.**

If you are investigating special events, please visit our trade show, fashion week, and event
calendar sections. You will find a wide assortment of relevant events to attend.

Fashionistas looking for their fix of apparel industry news, employment opportunities, trend
forecasting, etc., you have come to the proper place. We have entire sections of our site dedicated
to fashion news, fashion jobs, fashion trends, etc.

Apparel Search is your portal to the world of style. For the trend setting consumer, have fun
searching for the next trendy design, color, fabrics, & indie boutiques.  Enjoy the experience of
researching the market that we all cherish.

The world of fashion is in constant change. Apparel Search is here to help guide you on your quest
to learn more about our industry. Gain a better understanding of the clothing we design, as well as
shoes, accessories, and even some beauty products on occasion.

The super trendy fashion consumer section of our website should not be missed. Although our site is
primarily geared to members of our industry, you will find that we have recently expanded to help
consumers as well.

Apparel Search provides convenient access to our favorite luxury boutiques.
* Barney's
* Bloomingdales
* Neiman Marcus
* Nordstrom

We also find inspiration by researching & reviewing department stores, mass merchants, specialty
shops, and various online marketplaces.
* Etsy
* ASOS
* Shopify
* Amazon
* ShopStyle
* FashionNova
* Forever21

Visiting retail locations in your local area or online is a great place to turn to when we want to
quickly investigate multiple clothing brands and silhouettes. Many boutiques carefully curate
collections of both classic and trendy styles so you can quickly locate everything from your
favorite tried-and-true denim brands to pieces from up-and-coming designers. Visit our retailer
section to search for a versatile clothing selection which includes popular brands as well as
emerging designers. Find shoes, handbags, and other fashion accessories.

Stylish fashionistas take makeup and other beauty products into account when embracing their true
sense of style. Don't forget to stop by our beauty guide to read up on the latest products. Find
reviews and give advice to others so that we can all look as beautiful as you.

We hope that you love [ apparel][15] as much as we do.  Clothing is a fiber and textile material
worn on the body.  The most obvious function of clothing is to improve the comfort of the wearer, by
protecting the wearer from the elements. However, our garments are way more important than simply
keeping us warm & comfortable.  The shirts, pants, sweaters, and dresses that hang in *our wardrobes
also provide a glimpse into our lifestyle*, experiences and aspirations.  The clothes, handbags,
belts and shoes that we wear, have in our closet, or wish we owned, tell a story about who we are or
who we wish to become.  Take some time to learn more about garments, style, and our industry.
* Utilize our website to *explore the international business of fashion*. 

Style choices & fabulous trends start with you. Learn about clothing manufacturers, wholesalers,
retailers, and much more. Join us as we explore clothes, shoes, trendy accessories, and all other
aspects of the [ fashion industry][16].

Hopefully you find our site to be of interest.

You have a clear picture of what you want your business to look like, we'll help you find the RIGHT

Once we help you pick the right hardware and software we'll work with you on pricing and financing
options. You commit yourself to get started - we're going to help every way we can.

This is where you'll really notice the difference in partnering with ColDesi. Everything we do next
revolves around you. Getting you set up. Your Training. Your Support. Your questions answered for a

## How It Works

Take these simple steps to match your dream to the right tools:

### Step 1 — What do you want to do?

You have a clear picture of what you want your business to look like, we'll help you find the RIGHT
tools to make that a reality. This step is less about how to do it, and more about what you want.
The ColDesi team is there to help you figure out how to do it!

### Step 2 — Act on your dream.

Once we help you pick the right hardware and software we'll work with you on pricing and financing
options. You commit yourself to get started - we're going to help every way we can.

### Step 3 — Follow through.

This is where you'll really notice the difference in partnering with ColDesi. Everything we do next
revolves around you. Getting you set up. Your Training. Your Support. Your questions answered for a
FAST START to achieving your dream.

### Professional Team

You get all the information you need from people that know more about more things in customization
than anyone.

### Marketing Advice

Of COURSE you get trained on the equipment - but business don't fail because they can't figure out
how to work a machine. It's because they don't know how to make the phone ring. We'll show you how.

### Latest Technology

Up to date choices - that's what you want to make the best decision on technology. We'll tell you
what's now, and what's next.

# Double Diamond Services, Inc

Embroidery Machine Repair with Integrity

[ Read More][7]

### Maintenance

Service and maintenance to your embroidery machine.

### Service

With more than 25 years of experience, I know all the ins and outs of Tajima's line of industrial
embroidery machines.

### Consulting

When you need training on the controller, application, production ideas, work flow, or you need
advice on purchasing a new machine.

## Machine Types

* TMARK
* TMFX
* TMEDC
* TMEHC
* TMFD
* TMEHX
* TFMX
* Chenille/Mix
* Chenille/Standard

## The DDSC Approach

I highly value integrity and honesty in working with my customers, as well as in my personal life.
You need to be able to trust the technician who is working on your embroidery machine or giving you
advice on machine-related decisions that are so important to your business. My customers and their
business are my primary concerns. I will always give you unbiased information about your machine or
the potential purchase of a machine you might be considering.

[Integrity]
[Degree Wheel]

## My Years Of Experience at DDSC

My journey started March 18th, 1996 with SEDECO. I was hired by Jim Yates and began my training. For
several months I trained with other techs here in the U.S. then I trained for a month in Nogoya,
Japan. In those days, the average machine sale was 12 and 18 head machines. There were a lot of
large factories producing embroidery as fast as they could. I stayed very busy installing and
servicing those big machines. When Hirsch purchased SEDECO in 1997, I continued to work as a field
service technician until March of 2007 when I became the service manager for Hirsch International’s
South East Division. My area of responsibility included 13 states in the south east region of the
United States. I also stayed in the field during that period as a full time field technician. In
December of 2012 I left Hirsch International to go out on my own. While I do not work directly for
Hirsch International any longer I still have a close working relationship with them as an
independent contractor.

**

## Contact Us

Double Diamond Services, Inc.
Don Cameron
Call me: 940-859-3926
Snail Mail:
594 FM 3028
Millsap, TX 76066
Email Me:  [support@ddsc.us][8]

# Your Local Embroidery Machine Distributor

Embroidery Machines USA is the **official distributor for Aries & HoliHope embroidery machines in
the US.** We offer industrial embroidery machine models, single, dual-head, multiheads 4 or 6 heads.

All models are equipped with large main drivers for tough garments and 3D puff caps, **Warranty
ranging from 5 to 10 years on motors**. US Based tech support, serving the 48 continental United
States, which means you can connect directly with your technicians to get the support & training
your need.

### Industrial Embroidery Machines

All our machines feature large **24/7 industrial motors and easy panel features** that will allow

# Küresel Pazarlara
# TurkExim ile Açılın

Dünya genelinde **39'dan fazla stratejik ülkeden** gerçek ithalatçı ve ihracatçı konşimento (Bill of
Lading) verilerine ulaşın. Rakiplerinizi analiz edin, yeni pazarlar keşfedin ve ticaret hacminizi
genişletin.

[ Veritabanını İncele ][25] [ Üyelik Paketlerini Gör ][26]
39+ Ülke Resmi Gümrük Beyan Verisi
%100 Gerçek Konşimento Kanıtları ve Sevkiyatlar
Kesintisiz 7/24 Erişim ve Güncel Veri Akışı

## Küresel Ticari İstihbarat ve Analiz Hizmetleri

TurkExim'in dış ticarette neden en güvenilir iş ortağınız olduğunu keşfedin.

### Biz Kimiz?

TurkExim, dünya çapındaki 39'dan fazla ülkede ithalatçı ve ihracatçı firmaların doğrudan ve şeffaf
bağlar kurmasına olanak tanıyan küresel bir ticari istihbarat platformudur. Milyonlarca ham gümrük
beyannamesini işlenebilir ticari verilere dönüştürerek satış ekiplerinizin nokta atışı ihracat
hedeflerine ulaşmasını sağlıyoruz.

[ Çözümlerimizi Keşfedin → ][27]

### Konşimento Veritabanı (Bill of Lading)

TurkExim Konşimento Veritabanı, gümrüklerde kullanılan Armonize Sistem (GTİP / HS Code) kodlarına
göre sevkiyat analizleri sunar. Rakip firmaların hangi alıcılara, ne miktarda, hangi tarihlerde
yükleme yaptığını tam şeffaflıkla inceleyebilir ve tedarik zincirindeki hareketleri gerçek zamanlı
görebilirsiniz.

[ Konşimento Verilerini İnceleyin → ][28]

## Canlı Veri Arama Deneyimi

GTİP veya Ürün Adı girerek küresel veri tabanımızın nasıl çalıştığını simüle edin.

Sorgula

#### Bulunan Potansiyel Alıcı Analizleri

## Sıkça Sorulan Sorular - Dış Ticaret & Gümrük İstihbaratı

Küresel ticaret veri analitiği, gümrük sorgulamaları ve konşimento hakkında merak edilen tüm
sorulara doğrudan yanıtlar.

### S: TurkExim ithalat-ihracat veritabanı nedir ve ne işe yarar?

**TurkExim**, 39'dan fazla ülkenin resmi gümrük kayıtlarını ve deniz taşımacılığı yük
manifestolarını (konşimento/manifest) derleyen gelişmiş bir ticari istihbarat arama motorudur. Hangi
ithalatçının, hangi tür ürünleri, hangi sıklıkla, hangi hacimlerde ve hangi tedarikçilerden satın
aldığını anında tespit etmenizi sağlar. Böylece pazar pazar gezmeden hedef alıcılarınızı masa
başında belirleyebilirsiniz.

### S: Konşimento (Bill of Lading) verilerini analiz etmek ihracatçılara ne fayda sağlar?

Konşimento analizleri, B2B ticaret dünyasında küresel bir alıcının aktifliğini ve gerçek işlem
hacimlerini doğrulamanın en güvenilir yoludur. Klasik firma dizinlerinin aksine konşimentolar,
fiziksel bir sevkiyatın gerçekleştiğini gümrük nezdinde resmi olarak belgeler. Bu sayede aktif
olmayan veya aracı olan paravan şirketleri filtreleyip doğrudan **gerçek alıcılara** ulaşma şansı
elde edersiniz.

### S: TurkExim verileri ile pazar araştırması ve rakip analizi nasıl yapılır?

Sistem üzerinden hedef ürününüzün **GTİP (HS Code)** numarasını sorguladığınızda şu analizlere
erişebilirsiniz:
* İlgili ürünü dünyada en çok satın alan ithalatçıların unvanları ve satın alma hacimleri.
* Rakiplerinizin yurt dışındaki müşterileri, hangi limanları kullandıkları ve yükleme sıklıkları.
* Süreklilik arz eden, finansal riski düşük ve gümrük işlemi düzenli olan sürdürülebilir ihracat
  kanalları.

## Güncel Duyurular ve Veritabanı

Gümrük ağımızı sürekli genişletiyor ve ihracata giden yolları kısaltıyoruz.

[ Tüm Duyurular → ][29]
YENI VERI SETI

### 8 Yeni Ülkenin Resmi Verileri Entegre Edildi

Küresel erişiminizi artırmak için gümrük ağı veri setlerimize şu stratejik pazarları da ekledik:
* ABD
* Ekvador
* Pakistan
* Uruguay
* Etiyopya
* Paraguay
* Panama
* Vietnam

### Bulut Altyapı Performans Güncellemesi

Veritabanı sorgu motorlarımızda gerçekleştirdiğimiz SQL ve NoSQL optimizasyonları sayesinde,
karmaşık GTİP ve çoklu ülke konşimento aramalarınız artık 3 kat daha hızlı yanıt veriyor.

# Küresel Pazarlara
# TurkExim ile Açılın

Dünya genelinde **39'dan fazla stratejik ülkeden** gerçek ithalatçı ve ihracatçı konşimento (Bill of
Lading) verilerine ulaşın. Rakiplerinizi analiz edin, yeni pazarlar keşfedin ve ticaret hacminizi
genişletin.

[ Veritabanını İncele ][25] [ Üyelik Paketlerini Gör ][26]
39+ Ülke Resmi Gümrük Beyan Verisi
%100 Gerçek Konşimento Kanıtları ve Sevkiyatlar

## Küresel Ticari İstihbarat ve Analiz Hizmetleri

TurkExim'in dış ticarette neden en güvenilir iş ortağınız olduğunu keşfedin.

### Biz Kimiz?

TurkExim, dünya çapındaki 39'dan fazla ülkede ithalatçı ve ihracatçı firmaların doğrudan ve şeffaf
bağlar kurmasına olanak tanıyan küresel bir ticari istihbarat platformudur. Milyonlarca ham gümrük
beyannamesini işlenebilir ticari verilere dönüştürerek satış ekiplerinizin nokta atışı ihracat
hedeflerine ulaşmasını sağlıyoruz.

[ Çözümlerimizi Keşfedin → ][27]

### Konşimento Veritabanı (Bill of Lading)

TurkExim Konşimento Veritabanı, gümrüklerde kullanılan Armonize Sistem (GTİP / HS Code) kodlarına
göre sevkiyat analizleri sunar. Rakip firmaların hangi alıcılara, ne miktarda, hangi tarihlerde
yükleme yaptığını tam şeffaflıkla inceleyebilir ve tedarik zincirindeki hareketleri gerçek zamanlı
görebilirsiniz.

[ Konşimento Verilerini İnceleyin → ][28]

## Canlı Veri Arama Deneyimi

GTİP veya Ürün Adı girerek küresel veri tabanımızın nasıl çalıştığını simüle edin.

Sorgula

#### Bulunan Potansiyel Alıcı Analizleri

## Sıkça Sorulan Sorular - Dış Ticaret & Gümrük İstihbaratı

Küresel ticaret veri analitiği, gümrük sorgulamaları ve konşimento hakkında merak edilen tüm
sorulara doğrudan yanıtlar.

### S: TurkExim ithalat-ihracat veritabanı nedir ve ne işe yarar?

**TurkExim**, 39'dan fazla ülkenin resmi gümrük kayıtlarını ve deniz taşımacılığı yük
manifestolarını (konşimento/manifest) derleyen gelişmiş bir ticari istihbarat arama motorudur. Hangi
ithalatçının, hangi tür ürünleri, hangi sıklıkla, hangi hacimlerde ve hangi tedarikçilerden satın
aldığını anında tespit etmenizi sağlar. Böylece pazar pazar gezmeden hedef alıcılarınızı masa
başında belirleyebilirsiniz.

### S: Konşimento (Bill of Lading) verilerini analiz etmek ihracatçılara ne fayda sağlar?

Konşimento analizleri, B2B ticaret dünyasında küresel bir alıcının aktifliğini ve gerçek işlem
hacimlerini doğrulamanın en güvenilir yoludur. Klasik firma dizinlerinin aksine konşimentolar,
fiziksel bir sevkiyatın gerçekleştiğini gümrük nezdinde resmi olarak belgeler. Bu sayede aktif
olmayan veya aracı olan paravan şirketleri filtreleyip doğrudan **gerçek alıcılara** ulaşma şansı
elde edersiniz.

### S: TurkExim verileri ile pazar araştırması ve rakip analizi nasıl yapılır?

Sistem üzerinden hedef ürününüzün **GTİP (HS Code)** numarasını sorguladığınızda şu analizlere
erişebilirsiniz:
* İlgili ürünü dünyada en çok satın alan ithalatçıların unvanları ve satın alma hacimleri.
* Rakiplerinizin yurt dışındaki müşterileri, hangi limanları kullandıkları ve yükleme sıklıkları.
* Süreklilik arz eden, finansal riski düşük ve gümrük işlemi düzenli olan sürdürülebilir ihracat
  kanalları.

## Güncel Duyurular ve Veritabanı

Gümrük ağımızı sürekli genişletiyor ve ihracata giden yolları kısaltıyoruz.

[ Tüm Duyurular → ][29]
YENI VERI SETI

### 8 Yeni Ülkenin Resmi Verileri Entegre Edildi

Küresel erişiminizi artırmak için gümrük ağı veri setlerimize şu stratejik pazarları da ekledik:
* ABD
* Ekvador
* Pakistan
* Uruguay
* Etiyopya
* Paraguay
* Panama
* Vietnam

### Bulut Altyapı Performans Güncellemesi

Veritabanı sorgu motorlarımızda gerçekleştirdiğimiz SQL ve NoSQL optimizasyonları sayesinde,
karmaşık GTİP ve çoklu ülke konşimento aramalarınız artık 3 kat daha hızlı yanıt veriyor.

Yayınlanma Tarihi: Yakın zamanda

müşterilerimize özel %20'ye varan indirim fırsatları başladı.

present, we export products to India, Pakistan, Thailand, the Middle East, South America, etc.

sequin/double-sequin/twin-sequin/four-sequin) embroidery machines, coiling mixed embroidery
machines, chain-stitch/chenille/towel mixed embroidery machines, cap/T-shirt embroidery machines,

With high-quality products, excellent services and a good reputation.

[Display Video][41]
[Training Class][42]

### About Us

Zhuji Jinyu Mechanical And Electrical Manufacturing Co., Ltd. was founded in 2002, Our company is a
high-tech enterprise, a professional supplier of Computerized Embroidery Machines. With high-quality
products, excellent services, and a good reputation, we have won great support from customers around
the world. Thus, our company scale has expanded. We also offer all kinds of OEM/ODM services. At
present, we export products to India, Pakistan, Thailand, the Middle East, South America, etc.

 

Our products cover flat embroidery machines, sequins (single
sequin/double-sequin/twin-sequin/four-sequin) embroidery machines, coiling mixed embroidery
machines, chain-stitch/chenille/towel mixed embroidery machines, cap/T-shirt embroidery machines,
laser mixed embroidery machines, super multi-head embroidery machines, quilting embroidery machines
and so on.

Drop us an email at **[[email protected]][43]** and we’ll get back to you as soon as possible. We

for sewing large and heavy-weight materials such as leather and artificial leather for car seats,
luxury bags, and sofas.

## ALLIANCE PARTNERS

# Hi, I’m Mandy Chamberlin

I am a machine embroidery addict who turned a hobby into several businesses and one very
enthusiastic community. Whether you are buying your first embroidery machine, need embroidery done,
want a design digitised or fancy stitching your way through a mystery, you are in the right place.
Pick your path below.

[Find Your Path ↓][19]
[Mandy Chamberlin waving hello in her embroidery studio]

## Where Would You Like to Go?

#### Embroidery Machines

New Zealand

Buying an embroidery machine is a big decision, and the support you get matters just as much as the
machine itself. I specialise in Brother embroidery machines in New Zealand, with hands-on guidance,
training and ongoing support so you feel confident long after your machine arrives.

[Visit EmbroideryMachines.co.nz][20]

#### Embroidery Services

New Zealand

Custom embroidery for businesses, teams and individuals around New Zealand. Whether it is two
hundred uniforms or one special keepsake, it gets stitched with the same care, by me.

[Explore Embroidery Services][21]

#### Embroidery Digitising

Worldwide

Anyone can make a design look good on a computer screen. What matters is how it actually stitches on
fabric. I build embroidery files by hand for embroidery businesses and embroiderers all over the
world.

[Explore Digitising Services][22]

#### Mystery, She Sewed

Worldwide

A stitch-along where storytelling and stitching come together. Uncover an embroidered mystery one
clue at a time, alongside embroiderers who love a good whodunit as much as I do.

[Discover Mystery, She Sewed][23]

#### Learn With Mandy

NZ and online

Workshops, one-on-one tuition, business mentoring and speaking. If you want to get more from your
machine or your embroidery business, start here.

[Learn With Mandy][24]

## Why Work With Me?
* **I have done the thing, not just written about it.** More than ten years selling machines,
  digitising designs, running production and teaching. Whatever has gone wrong in your hoop, chances
  are it went wrong in mine first.
* **Trusted by a community of thousands.** I founded [NZ Machine Embroidery Addicts][25] in 2017
  because I could not find a community for Kiwi machine embroiderers, so I built one.
* **Official credentials.** Brother dealer, NZ Agent for Echidna Sewing and Halo dealer, backed by
  real local training and support.
* **No pressure, ever.** I would much rather help you choose the right machine than talk you into
  the wrong one. That approach built everything you see here.

[Mandy Chamberlin helping students at a machine embroidery workshop in Auckland]
[Close-up of applique embroidery detail with floral stitching]

#### ★★★★★

“She really knows her stuff, explained the options clearly, and made the whole process super easy.
Great customer service, very knowledgeable, and genuinely friendly. Highly recommend.”

**Cyrus**, Google review

#### ★★★★★

“I needed to get some polo shirts embroidered to promote my business. The quality of the embroidery
and polo shirts is amazing and Mandy was so helpful in getting the design to work effectively.”

**Janice**, Google review

#### ★★★★★

“Mandy was super accommodating to all my requests even considering the very short notice. I was
absolutely thrilled with the outcome.”

**Ashlee**, Google review

## Stay Connected

Practical embroidery tips, project inspiration, workshop dates and first news on Mystery, She Sewed.
I only send it when I have something worth saying, because we both have enough email already.

# Hi, I’m Mandy Chamberlin

I am a machine embroidery addict who turned a hobby into several businesses and one very
enthusiastic community. Whether you are buying your first embroidery machine, need embroidery done,
want a design digitised or fancy stitching your way through a mystery, you are in the right place.
Pick your path below.

[Find Your Path ↓][19]
[Mandy Chamberlin waving hello in her embroidery studio]

## Where Would You Like to Go?

#### Embroidery Machines

New Zealand

Buying an embroidery machine is a big decision, and the support you get matters just as much as the
machine itself. I specialise in Brother embroidery machines in New Zealand, with hands-on guidance,
training and ongoing support so you feel confident long after your machine arrives.

[Visit EmbroideryMachines.co.nz][20]

#### Embroidery Services

New Zealand

Custom embroidery for businesses, teams and individuals around New Zealand. Whether it is two
hundred uniforms or one special keepsake, it gets stitched with the same care, by me.

[Explore Embroidery Services][21]

#### Embroidery Digitising

Worldwide

Anyone can make a design look good on a computer screen. What matters is how it actually stitches on
fabric. I build embroidery files by hand for embroidery businesses and embroiderers all over the
world.

[Explore Digitising Services][22]

#### Mystery, She Sewed

Worldwide

A stitch-along where storytelling and stitching come together. Uncover an embroidered mystery one
clue at a time, alongside embroiderers who love a good whodunit as much as I do.

[Discover Mystery, She Sewed][23]

#### Learn With Mandy

NZ and online

Workshops, one-on-one tuition, business mentoring and speaking. If you want to get more from your
machine or your embroidery business, start here.

[Learn With Mandy][24]

## Why Work With Me?
* **I have done the thing, not just written about it.** More than ten years selling machines,
  digitising designs, running production and teaching. Whatever has gone wrong in your hoop, chances
  are it went wrong in mine first.
* **Trusted by a community of thousands.** I founded [NZ Machine Embroidery Addicts][25] in 2017
  because I could not find a community for Kiwi machine embroiderers, so I built one.
* **Official credentials.** Brother dealer, NZ Agent for Echidna Sewing and Halo dealer, backed by
  real local training and support.
* **No pressure, ever.** I would much rather help you choose the right machine than talk you into
  the wrong one. That approach built everything you see here.

[Mandy Chamberlin helping students at a machine embroidery workshop in Auckland]
[Close-up of applique embroidery detail with floral stitching]

#### ★★★★★

“She really knows her stuff, explained the options clearly, and made the whole process super easy.
Great customer service, very knowledgeable, and genuinely friendly. Highly recommend.”

**Cyrus**, Google review

#### ★★★★★

“I needed to get some polo shirts embroidered to promote my business. The quality of the embroidery
and polo shirts is amazing and Mandy was so helpful in getting the design to work effectively.”

**Janice**, Google review

#### ★★★★★

“Mandy was super accommodating to all my requests even considering the very short notice. I was
absolutely thrilled with the outcome.”

**Ashlee**, Google review

## Stay Connected

Practical embroidery tips, project inspiration, workshop dates and first news on Mystery, She Sewed.
I only send it when I have something worth saying, because we both have enough email already.

Join the List

### Mandy Chamberlin

Everything embroidery: machines, custom embroidery, digitising and the odd mystery. Based in
Auckland, New Zealand, working with embroiderers everywhere.

### Industrial & Specialty Machines

The **Pfaff Industrial Sewing Machine**, **Pfaff Tipmatic 6270**, **Pfaff 1245**, and **Pfaff Home
Sewing Machines** cover heavy-duty and specialty needs. Whether working with leather, upholstery, or
everyday fabrics, these powerhouses deliver unmatched strength, speed, and consistent
professional-level performance daily.

#### Built for Uncompromising Stitch Quality

Every PFAFF machine is the result of meticulous German engineering, where every component is
designed to deliver flawless, reliable performance stitch after stitch.

01
Steel-Reinforced Internal Frame
A rigid, steel-reinforced chassis minimizes vibration at high speeds, ensuring your seams stay
perfectly straight even when sewing through multiple layers of denim or canvas. This durable
construction is built to last for decades.
02
Precision-Machined Needle Bar
The needle bar is machined to tolerances within 0.01 millimeters, guaranteeing consistent needle
penetration through delicate silks or heavy upholstery fabrics without skipped stitches or needle
deflection.
03
Optimized Bobbin Case Geometry
Unlike generic bobbin cases, PFAFF’s uniquely shaped case prevents thread snags and ensures even
tension distribution, resulting in 23% fewer thread jams compared to standard designs in independent
testing.
04
Low-Friction Thread Path
A polished ceramic thread guide and calibrated tension discs reduce friction by up to 40%,
preventing thread breakage and allowing smoother sewing with specialty threads like metallic or
invisible nylon.
05
Direct-Drive Motor System
A powerful, brushless DC motor provides instant, precise speed control from 1 to 1,200 stitches per
minute, offering superior needle penetration force for leather and other challenging materials.
06
Sealed Gear Transmission
A fully sealed, oil-free gear system operates quietly and requires no user lubrication, protecting
the internal mechanics from dust and lint buildup that can degrade performance over time.

#### One Brand for Every Stitch You'll Ever Make

From the first seam on a simple skirt to the final embroidery on a queen-sized quilt, PFAFF has a
dedicated machine line built for your craft. Each series is engineered for a specific kind of maker,
so you can focus on creating instead of compromising.

Performance

【For: Sewists and quilters who tackle multi-layered garments, heirloom quilts, and need
professional-level stitch control.】 Computerized workhorses packed with hundreds of stitches, large
touchscreens, and generous harp space for complex sewing and quilting projects. Includes: PFAFF
Performance 5.0

Expression

【For: Creative makers who move between garment construction, quilting, and adding custom embroidery
designs.】 Versatile all-in-one machines that handle sewing, quilting, and embroidery with intuitive
color touchscreens and automatic needle threaders. Includes: PFAFF Expression Line

Creative

【For: Embroidery enthusiasts and small business owners who prioritize design size, precision, and
built-in editing features.】 Dedicated embroidery machines featuring expansive embroidery areas for
large-scale designs, monograms, and intricate detail work. Includes: PFAFF Creative 4.5

Quilt Ambition

【For: Dedicated quilters who want reliable performance for piecing, appliqué, and free-motion work
without unnecessary complexity.】 Intuitive machines designed specifically for the demands of
quilting, balancing advanced features with ease of use for confident quilt construction. Includes:
PFAFF Quilt Ambition 635

Passport

【For: Sewists who need a portable machine for travel, workshops, or as a reliable secondary machine
at home.】 Compact, lightweight models under 15 lbs that fold down for easy transport to classes,
retreats, or small-space living. Includes: PFAFF Passport 3.0

admir air

【For: Garment makers who want clean, durable seams and rolled hems without the setup time of
traditional sergers.】 Air-threading overlock sergers that eliminate the frustration of manual
threading for fast, professional seam finishing on knits and wovens. Includes: PFAFF admire air 5000

###### THE PFAFF ORIGIN

#### From German Workshop to Your Creative Studio

Every PFAFF machine begins its journey at our Kaiserslautern factory, where German craftsmanship
meets modern manufacturing precision. The same facility that once produced industrial equipment now
calibrates the tension systems and assembles the feed mechanisms that advanced sewists rely on for
flawless control. This direct lineage means the technology in your home studio was pressure-tested
in environments where failure isn’t an option.

We build for the creative professional who treats their craft with the seriousness of an engineer.
Whether you’re a garment maker running a small business, an educator teaching complex techniques, or
a quilter pushing artistic boundaries, the machine on your table was designed to meet that exacting
standard. It’s precision that becomes invisible in your hands, letting the work speak for itself.

### Industrial & Specialty Machines

The **Pfaff Industrial Sewing Machine**, **Pfaff Tipmatic 6270**, **Pfaff 1245**, and **Pfaff Home

#### Built for Uncompromising Stitch Quality

Every PFAFF machine is the result of meticulous German engineering, where every component is
designed to deliver flawless, reliable performance stitch after stitch.

01
Steel-Reinforced Internal Frame
A rigid, steel-reinforced chassis minimizes vibration at high speeds, ensuring your seams stay
perfectly straight even when sewing through multiple layers of denim or canvas. This durable
construction is built to last for decades.
02
Precision-Machined Needle Bar
The needle bar is machined to tolerances within 0.01 millimeters, guaranteeing consistent needle
penetration through delicate silks or heavy upholstery fabrics without skipped stitches or needle
deflection.
03
Optimized Bobbin Case Geometry
Unlike generic bobbin cases, PFAFF’s uniquely shaped case prevents thread snags and ensures even
tension distribution, resulting in 23% fewer thread jams compared to standard designs in independent
testing.
04
Low-Friction Thread Path
A polished ceramic thread guide and calibrated tension discs reduce friction by up to 40%,
preventing thread breakage and allowing smoother sewing with specialty threads like metallic or
invisible nylon.
05
Direct-Drive Motor System
A powerful, brushless DC motor provides instant, precise speed control from 1 to 1,200 stitches per
minute, offering superior needle penetration force for leather and other challenging materials.
06
Sealed Gear Transmission
A fully sealed, oil-free gear system operates quietly and requires no user lubrication, protecting
the internal mechanics from dust and lint buildup that can degrade performance over time.

#### One Brand for Every Stitch You'll Ever Make

From the first seam on a simple skirt to the final embroidery on a queen-sized quilt, PFAFF has a
dedicated machine line built for your craft. Each series is engineered for a specific kind of maker,
so you can focus on creating instead of compromising.

Performance

【For: Sewists and quilters who tackle multi-layered garments, heirloom quilts, and need
professional-level stitch control.】 Computerized workhorses packed with hundreds of stitches, large

Creative

built-in editing features.】 Dedicated embroidery machines featuring expansive embroidery areas for
large-scale designs, monograms, and intricate detail work. Includes: PFAFF Creative 4.5

【For: Dedicated quilters who want reliable performance for piecing, appliqué, and free-motion work
without unnecessary complexity.】 Intuitive machines designed specifically for the demands of
quilting, balancing advanced features with ease of use for confident quilt construction. Includes:

【For: Sewists who need a portable machine for travel, workshops, or as a reliable secondary machine

admir air

【For: Garment makers who want clean, durable seams and rolled hems without the setup time of

#### From German Workshop to Your Creative Studio

Every PFAFF machine begins its journey at our Kaiserslautern factory, where German craftsmanship
meets modern manufacturing precision. The same facility that once produced industrial equipment now
calibrates the tension systems and assembles the feed mechanisms that advanced sewists rely on for
flawless control. This direct lineage means the technology in your home studio was pressure-tested
in environments where failure isn’t an option.

We build for the creative professional who treats their craft with the seriousness of an engineer.
Whether you’re a garment maker running a small business, an educator teaching complex techniques, or
a quilter pushing artistic boundaries, the machine on your table was designed to meet that exacting
standard. It’s precision that becomes invisible in your hands, letting the work speak for itself.

#### About the Designer Behind Royal Present Embroidery

Royal Present Embroidery is created by [Ludmila Konvalova][168], a professional machine embroidery
designer and digitizer with long-term experience in digital embroidery files for real stitching
projects. Each collection is developed with attention to stitch quality, thread behavior, fabric
type, hoop size, density, trims and practical use on finished products.

The goal of Royal Present Embroidery is to offer machine embroidery designs that look beautiful on
screen and are suitable for real embroidery machines, real fabrics and real customer projects.

#### License and Use

All machine embroidery designs are sold as digital files for personal and commercial use. You may
embroider finished items and sell them at craft fairs, Etsy, local markets or through your own
business. You may not sell, share, copy or redistribute the digital files themselves.

## Machine Embroidery Designs Online for Creative Stitching Projects

**Royal Present Embroidery** is an online store of digital machine embroidery designs for embroidery
machines. Here you can download embroidery files for Brother, Janome, Bernina, Baby Lock, Pfaff,
Husqvarna Viking and other popular embroidery machines.
Our catalog includes floral embroidery designs, monograms, appliqué, in-the-hoop projects, borders,
corners, quilt blocks, lace, redwork, holiday embroidery, wedding embroidery, baby designs, towel
embroidery, napkin embroidery, home decor patterns and designs for clothing and accessories.
Each design is created as a digital embroidery file for real stitching projects. After purchase, you
receive a ZIP archive with machine embroidery formats, color information and design details. No
physical item is shipped.
Use Royal Present embroidery designs to decorate towels, napkins, table linens, pillowcases, robes,
bags, children’s clothes, holiday gifts, wedding accessories, nursery items and handmade products
for sale.

### Find machine embroidery designs by project
* [Floral machine embroidery designs][170] for clothing, linens, towels, pillows and home decor
* [Monogram frames machine embroidery designs][171] for initials, names, napkins, handkerchiefs and
  personalized gifts
* [Appliqué machine embroidery designs][172] for fabric projects, children’s items, bags and
  decorative sewing
* [Machine embroidery borders][173] for towels, table runners, napkins, curtains and decorative
  edges
* [Corner embroidery designs][174] for table linens, napkins, pillowcases, handkerchiefs and elegant
  textile details
* [Sets of machine embroidery designs][175] for coordinated projects, collections and matching
  handmade gifts
* [New machine embroidery designs][176]  for fresh seasonal projects and recently added collections

### What you receive after purchase
* digital machine embroidery files for embroidery machines
* ZIP archive available for download after payment
* formats for popular embroidery machines
* color charts and stitch information where included
* designs created for real fabrics, stabilizers and hoop sizes

Before transferring files to your embroidery machine, unzip the downloaded archive and choose only
the format supported by your machine. If you need help opening a ZIP archive, use our free [online
ZIP unzip tool][177]

### Useful embroidery tips before stitching
* **For towels:** use water-soluble topping so the stitches do not sink into the pile.
* **For napkins and table linens:** test the design on similar fabric first, especially if the
  design has borders, corners or monograms.
* **For clothing:** choose stabilizer according to fabric stretch, weight and stitch density.

#### About the Designer Behind Royal Present Embroidery

Royal Present Embroidery is created by [Ludmila Konvalova][168], a professional machine embroidery
designer and digitizer with long-term experience in digital embroidery files for real stitching
projects. Each collection is developed with attention to stitch quality, thread behavior, fabric
type, hoop size, density, trims and practical use on finished products.

The goal of Royal Present Embroidery is to offer machine embroidery designs that look beautiful on
screen and are suitable for real embroidery machines, real fabrics and real customer projects.

#### License and Use

All machine embroidery designs are sold as digital files for personal and commercial use. You may

business. You may not sell, share, copy or redistribute the digital files themselves.

## Machine Embroidery Designs Online for Creative Stitching Projects

**Royal Present Embroidery** is an online store of digital machine embroidery designs for embroidery
machines. Here you can download embroidery files for Brother, Janome, Bernina, Baby Lock, Pfaff,
Husqvarna Viking and other popular embroidery machines.
Our catalog includes floral embroidery designs, monograms, appliqué, in-the-hoop projects, borders,
corners, quilt blocks, lace, redwork, holiday embroidery, wedding embroidery, baby designs, towel
embroidery, napkin embroidery, home decor patterns and designs for clothing and accessories.
Each design is created as a digital embroidery file for real stitching projects. After purchase, you
receive a ZIP archive with machine embroidery formats, color information and design details. No
physical item is shipped.
Use Royal Present embroidery designs to decorate towels, napkins, table linens, pillowcases, robes,
bags, children’s clothes, holiday gifts, wedding accessories, nursery items and handmade products
for sale.

### Find machine embroidery designs by project
* [Floral machine embroidery designs][170] for clothing, linens, towels, pillows and home decor
* [Monogram frames machine embroidery designs][171] for initials, names, napkins, handkerchiefs and
  personalized gifts
* [Appliqué machine embroidery designs][172] for fabric projects, children’s items, bags and
  decorative sewing
* [Machine embroidery borders][173] for towels, table runners, napkins, curtains and decorative
  edges
* [Corner embroidery designs][174] for table linens, napkins, pillowcases, handkerchiefs and elegant
  textile details
* [Sets of machine embroidery designs][175] for coordinated projects, collections and matching
  handmade gifts
* [New machine embroidery designs][176]  for fresh seasonal projects and recently added collections

### What you receive after purchase
* digital machine embroidery files for embroidery machines
* ZIP archive available for download after payment
* formats for popular embroidery machines
* color charts and stitch information where included
* designs created for real fabrics, stabilizers and hoop sizes

Before transferring files to your embroidery machine, unzip the downloaded archive and choose only
the format supported by your machine. If you need help opening a ZIP archive, use our free [online
ZIP unzip tool][177]

### Useful embroidery tips before stitching
* **For towels:** use water-soluble topping so the stitches do not sink into the pile.
* **For napkins and table linens:** test the design on similar fabric first, especially if the
  design has borders, corners or monograms.
* **For clothing:** choose stabilizer according to fabric stretch, weight and stitch density.

# TAJIMA AMERICA CORP.

In 1964, the TAJIMA group developed a multi-head embroidery machine. Since then, we have made
expensive manually produced embroidery accessible and familiar to the peoples of the world, and
added beauty to their lives. What we have cultivated are extremely artisanal skills of "sewing",
advanced engineering technology of "control" to be mechanically realized, and technology of
"multi-head making" suitable for our originality and ingenuity for these "sewing", "control" and
"multi-head making" skills and combine and nurture them to provide high value-added products so that
our products can please our customers throughout the world.

[Learn More][8]
[image-ez-1a.jpg]

### TMEZ-SC SERIES

The TMEZ from Tajima is the world's first embroidery machine with automatic thread tension
adjustment! i-TM technology eliminates the need for manual tension adjustment from the operator. The
presser foot automatically detects the fabric thickness and evaluates the upcoming stitch type.
Automatic adjustments are made according to stitch length, stitch direction, type of stitch, machine
speed and thickness of the fabric.

[Learn more][9]
[TMBR2.jpg]

### TMBR2-SC SERIES

TMBR2-SC multi-head flat type high-end model embroidery machine allows you to add a wide variety of
embroidery to finished products, and the DCP provides a precise and beautiful finish, regardless of
the material. Available in up to 18 colors, it is suitable for name and emblem embroidery on
uniforms, hats, socks, bags, etc., and for embroidery processing in stores.

[Learn more][10]
[TMBP2.jpg]

### TMBP2-SC SERIES

The TMBP2-SC single-head cylinder type standard model embroidery machine with basic functions. It
handles up to 15 colors and is suitable for name and emblem embroidery on uniforms, hats, socks,
bags, etc., and for embroidery processing in stores. Despite its compact body, the machine is
equipped with a maximum of 15 colors and a wide embroidery field of 360 mm (14.4inches) (D) x 500 mm
(20 inches) (W) to meet a variety of needs.

[Learn more][11]
[TMBP2.jpg]

### TMBP2-XC SERIES

The TMBP2-SC is a single-head cylinder type standard model embroidery machine capable of
embroidering over a wide field.
The maximum embroidery field is 550 x 600 mm, Tajima’s largest single-head embroidery field, and can
handle large embroideries on dresses, sports jerseys, tablecloths, curtains, bedding, and more.
Also, as with our other single-heads, a wide variety of frame types are available, allowing
embroidery on a wide range of items such as caps and bags.


[Learn more][12]
[TMEZ-KC_UR01.jpg]

### TMEZ-KC SERIES

The TMEZ-KC series multi-head cylinder type embroidery machines are equipped with Tajima’s latest
and most advanced technologies. It is suited for logo and emblem embroidery on products such as
sports uniforms and hats in small to medium quantities. The i-TM and DCP allow even embroidery
beginners to work on any material, at high speed and with stable quality.

[Learn more][13]
[image-arkc2-01.jpg]

### TMAR-KC TYPE2 SERIES

The TMAR-KC multi-head cylinder type high-end model embroidery machine allows you to add a wide
variety of embroidery to finished products, and the DCP provides a precise and beautiful finish,
regardless of the material. It is suited for embroidering logos and emblems on finished products
such as sports uniforms and hats in small to medium quantities.
*The TMAR-KC is configured with 2 to 8 heads, the TMAR-VC with 12 heads.

[Learn more][14]
[image-fmx2c-4-1.jpg]

### TFMX-ⅡC TYPE２ SERIES

The TFMX-IIC offers standard multi-head cylinder type machines with basic functions.
It is suited for embroidering logos and marks on small to medium quantities of finished products
such as sports uniforms and hats. It is suitable for processing multiple pieces of the same pattern.

[Learn more][15]
[image-arvc-1-1536x817.jpg]

### TMAR-VC SERIES

The TMAR-VC multi-head cylinder type high-end model embroidery machine allows you to add a wide
variety of embroidery to finished products, and the DCP provides a precise and beautiful finish,
regardless of the material. It is suited for embroidering logos and marks on finished products such
as sports uniforms and hats in large quantities.
*The TMAR-KC is configured with 2 to 8 heads, the TMAR-VC with 12 heads.

[Learn more][16]
[image-cr-1.jpg]

From TAJIMA, the top manufacturer of embroidery machines that the world's first-class brands have

## CAREER OPPORTUNITIES

Tajima embroidery machines are one of the most popular commercial embroidery machines in the world.
Tajima America Corporation is a wholly owned subsidiary of TAJIMA Industries Ltd, Japan.

### SALES REPRESENTATIVE

Job Description


Responsible for executing the overall sales activities of a company or assigned South America market
in order to achieve organizational sales and profit objectives.

 

Objectives of this Role

* Represent our company’s products and services, starting with a deep and comprehensive
  understanding and following with consumer research to identify how our solutions meet needs

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

* Maintain working relationships with existing clients to ensure exceptional service and
  identification of potential new sales opportunities
* Possess in-depth product knowledge and be able to conduct demos and relay objection handling
* Coordinate with other sales reps to ensure company quotas and standards are being met, performing
  market research and regular competitor monitoring
* Shipping Documents  – Invoice, Packing List, Doc BL, Case Marks  - Communicating with the
  distributor back and forth
* Shipping schedules – updating the shipping schedules for distributors based on Tokai production
  list
* Statements of account – Updating monthly statements of account
* Accounts receivable – Following up with customers for payment
* Quotations/Breakdowns when necessary
* Updating Price Lists
* Following up with distributors regarding Trade Shows (machine lineup, demo designs, etc.)
* Business trips for Tradeshows, Seminars (create presentations), meetings, customer visits
* Report on current market situation/economy/future forecast for distributors

 

Skills and Qualifications
* 1-2 years in sales
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, problem-solving, presentation, and organizational skills
* Personal integrity
* Fluent in English and Spanish

 

Preferred Qualifications
* High school diploma or equivalent education required
* Ability to balance persuasion with professionalism
* Strong organizational skills

 

Work authorization:
* United States (Required)


Required license or certification:
* Driver's License


Language:
* English and Spanish


Salary: D.O.E.


To apply for this position, please send your resume with cover letter to: [recruit@tac-us.com][27]

## TAJIMA AMERICA CORP.

Started as Technical Service Center, Tajima America Corp. has been supporting Tajima distributors
and customers since its incorporation in 1990 in New Jersey, USA. The corporate headquarters was
relocated from New Jersey in 2004 along with our assembly facility in Long Island, New York to our
current location, Rancho Dominguez, California. From this location along with our new office in
Brazil, we provide in cooperation with Tajima Industries Ltd. and Tokai Industrial Sewing Machine
Co. Ltd. in Japan, sales and technical support for North, South, and Central America as part of the
Tajima Group.

Our showroom has the latest embroidery machines from Single head, 2-8 head and specialty machines
which can provide the customers with the up to date technologies from Tajima. 

Our mission is to provide our distributors and end users with the best possible support so that
their businesses can be as successful as possible. Every possible effort is made to keep them
supplied with the most up to date sales and market information in order for them to maintain optimum
sales activities. We also supply them with the most recent techniques and new embroidery
applications from around the world. Through seminars and meetings throughout all of the territories
that we provide services for, technical information and training ensures that the best possible
support is provided to our distributors and customers by our sales and technical staff.

*The TMAR-KC is configured with 2 to 8 heads, the TMAR-VC with 12 heads.

[Learn more][14]
[image-fmx2c-4-1.jpg]

### TFMX-ⅡC TYPE２ SERIES

The TFMX-IIC offers standard multi-head cylinder type machines with basic functions.
It is suited for embroidering logos and marks on small to medium quantities of finished products
such as sports uniforms and hats. It is suitable for processing multiple pieces of the same pattern.

[Learn more][15]
[image-arvc-1-1536x817.jpg]

### TMAR-VC SERIES

The TMAR-VC multi-head cylinder type high-end model embroidery machine allows you to add a wide
variety of embroidery to finished products, and the DCP provides a precise and beautiful finish,
regardless of the material. It is suited for embroidering logos and marks on finished products such
as sports uniforms and hats in large quantities.
*The TMAR-KC is configured with 2 to 8 heads, the TMAR-VC with 12 heads.

[Learn more][16]
[image-cr-1.jpg]

### TMCR-VF SERIES

The TMCR-VF is a multi-head flat type high-end model. The DCP provides a precise and beautiful
finish, regardless of the material. It is suited for factories that embroider fabrics and parts
before sewing, such as large-lot apparel products.

[Learn more][17]
[image-cp-1.jpg]

### TMCP-VF SERIES

The TMCP-VF series offers standard multi-head flat type machines with basic functions.
It is suited for factories that embroider on fabrics and parts before sewing, such as large-lot
apparel products.

[Learn more][18]
[PAX_edited.jpg]

### “PAX”—Perforation, multicolor sewing, and embroidery, all in one machine.

“PAX” handles perforation, multicolor sewing, and embroidery, all on one machine.
By combining three different processing methods, complex designs can be reproduced. It can be used
for seats and interiors of automobiles, cabin cruisers, and private jets as well as for interior
design, fashion accessories, and leathercraft. Also available for small-lot production, prototyping,
and development.

[Learn more][19]
[image-mx-1.jpg]

### TLMX SERIES (HEATER WIRE SEWING MACHINE)

Tajima TLMX series is an innovative combination machine that can sew heater wires. Equipped with
numerous advanced technologies to securely sew abundant materials. Stable sewing at high speed has
been achieved. The largest Heater Wire Sewing Machine with 16 heads, can produce 16 pieces at a
time. This greatly improves productivity and reduces cost per part. Automation with various options
simplifies the processes and increases productivity.

[Learn more][20]
[CMS-01 FR1.jpg]

### TCMX SERIES

The TCMX-601 is a single head 6 color automatic chenille machine that is perfect for the startup
chenille entrepreneur. Packed with advanced features and automatic functions, the TCMX-601 delivers
top quality stitching, quickly, easily and precisely. Intricate designs created via a variety of
stitch effects make it possible to re-produce virtually any logo in a chenille format, quickly,
easily and accurately.

[Learn more][21]
[SAI photo (1).jpg]

### TAJIMA SAI

A new world of embroidery business opened by SAI. It fits anywhere and it's reasonably priced, so
it's easy to start using it.


It has everything you need for your startup. It means you can get started, right now.


The toughness to keep on working, and a compact size and price.

The all-in-one package includes fonts and PC software.

## Instagram

[ [押さえがもう一段階上げられるの、知ってましたか？👀
ジャノメの多くのミシンでは、押さえを上げた状態から さらに上げることができます💡
▫️分厚い生地の出し入れ ▫️針板の交換 ▫️ファスナーを縫う時のセッティング
こんなとき、とても便利です🪄🪄 ミシンによっては上げた状態で固定することもできます❕
社内にあるミシンを確認しましたが、#メモリークラフト6700p は固定することができました✅
ぜひお試しください🙌🏻🙌🏻
※もう一段階高くなった状態で固定されないミシンがほとんどなので、急に手を離したりしないようご注意くだ
さい💡 ﹌﹌﹌﹌﹌﹌﹌﹌﹌﹌﹌﹌﹌﹌﹌ #ミシン #ミシン初心者 #ソーイング #ミシンはジャノメ] ][57]
[ [7/18(土)〜20(月)に開催された「ふくおかハンドメイド&雑貨フェスタ 2026・夏」が終了しました🍉✨
ご来場いただいた皆様、ジャノメブースにお越しいただいた皆様、ありがとうございました☺️
ジャノメブースでは2種類のワークショップ「レトロミシンの刺しゅう入りカードケース」「フローラル刺しゅ
うのブローチ」を開催！
連日沢山の方にご体験いただき、刺しゅうミシンの楽しさや手軽さを実感していただけました🌟
デモコーナーでは、業務用刺しゅう機MB-7や、刺しゅうデータ編集PCソフトアーティスティックデジタイザーを
実演！ 皆様刺しゅうミシンで出来る表現の幅広さに驚かれていました🪡
アーティスティックデジタイザーは、現在1か月無料でご利用いただけるトライアルキャンペーンを実施してお
ります！ ぜひ気になった方は、この機会にお試しください♪
引き続き、手作りの楽しさをお伝えできるようスタッフ一同頑張ってまいりますので、今後ともジャノメをよろ
しくお願いいたします🙇🏻✨ #ふくおかハンドメイドアンド雑貨フェスタ #福岡 #バンドメイド #ミシン
#ミシン刺しゅう #ジャノメ #ミシンはジャノメ #janome #sewingmachine] ][58]
[ [ソーインググッズたちを収納するケースを作りましょう✨ 転がりやすい目打ちやリッパ－、
すぐにどこにいったか分からなくなる糸切りばさみなどの小物系 などなど…。
収納ケースをミシンの横に置いておけば、いつでも簡単に取り出せますよ♪
裏布（内布）にビニールやラミネート素材を使用することで 糸くずなどのお手入れをしやすくしました。
形を変形させると裁ちばさみや定規も収納できちゃいます♪ あっという間に完成するので、
ぜひお気軽に試してみてくださいね！ @janome_sewing▷リンク「ミシンサイト」
▷SEWING▷レシピ「ノーションケース」 使用したミシン：セシオデイリー1000 #かんたんソーイング
#ソーインググッズ収納#ノーションケース#レシピ #ハンドメイド #ミシン#janome #sewingmachine] ][59]
[ [ボビナージュ(@janome_bobinage
)では毎月、初心者の方向けにバッグ作りとお洋服作りのワークショップを行っています🌱
アイテムは全部で４種類✨刺しゅう入り2wayバッグ、タックギャザースカート、タックパンツ、ドロップショル
ダーチュニック（冬季はブラウス）です。
ミシン初めてさんでもお気軽に参加していただけるよう、当日はミシンの操作説明からスタートします。
洋裁初心者さんにもおススメのワークショップですので、安心してご参加ください😊
ワークショップにご参加いただいた後もご自宅で作品作りを楽しんでいただけるように、型紙やレシピ付き！
生地と型紙の置き方などもしっかりお伝えしますので、ご受講の際は写真を撮ったり、レシピにどんどん記入し
てくださいね♪
バッグ、スカート、パンツ、チュニックのアイテムをひとつずつ順番に受講していくと、ミシンの使い方を学び
ながら自然にステップアップが可能です♪もちろん、お好みのアイテムだけのご受講も大歓迎！
ご予約はwebサイトまたはお電話にて受け付けております。
今までにご参加いただいたお客様の作品をご紹介します♪
自分で作ったアイテムを着た時の満足感はたまりません！
ミシンを使った手づくりを、あなたも一緒に始めてみませんか？ みなさまのご参加お待ちしております！
詳細はボビナージュWeb サイトをご覧ください✨ ▹◃┄▸◂┄▹◃┄▸◂┄▹◃┄▸◂┄▹◃ #ボビナージュ #bobinage

#ジャノメ #ジャノメミシン #ミシンはジャノメ #janome] ][60]
[ [夏休みは、ミシンでものづくり体験を🌻 「自分でつくれた❗️」という達成感を味わえる、
ジャノメの小・中学生向けソーイング教材をご紹介します。
今回つくるのは、ビニール素材を使った夏らしいバッグ✨
透明で中に入れたものが見える、涼しげなデザインです。
内ポケットには、ミシン刺しゅうや飾り模様を入れて、自分だけのアレンジも楽しめます♪
持ち手はピンクとブルーの2色から選べます🩷🩵 ≪ミシンに触れて、ひとつの作品を完成させる。≫
夏休みのものづくり体験や、自由研究のきっかけにもおすすめです。

What is embroidery digitizing?

It is the process of converting your design or image into an embroidery machine-readable file using
embroidery software. It includes stitch types with their directions and thread colors so the machine
can precisely recreate the design on fabric. 

What is the best program to digitize embroidery?

You can use online digitizing services like ZDigitizing. Simply upload your design, provide your
requirements, and receive the file.

How much does it cost to digitize embroidery designs?

The cost of digitizing depends on various factors like your design size, design complexity, color
changes, and whether you need urgent delivery. So, the cost may vary from $10 to $40. 

When will I get my embroidery digitized file back?

From ZDigitizing, you’ll get your design back within few hours (4-12 hours). But if you need urgent
design, you’ll get it in 1 to 4 hours. Remember, a complex design may take time.

You can submit in any form, such as PNG, JPG, PDF, or TIFF. Just ensure that the design is clear and
of high quality, so we can ensure the best results.

## Frequently Asked Questions About ZDigitizing

Here’s everything you need to know about our **embroidery digitizing** services, including process,
pricing, and delivery.

What is embroidery digitizing?

It is the process of converting your design or image into an embroidery machine-readable file using
embroidery software. It includes stitch types with their directions and thread colors so the machine
can precisely recreate the design on fabric. 

What is the best program to digitize embroidery?

There are lots of software available to digitize for embroidery, like:
1. Wilcome Embroidery Studio 
2. Hatch Embroidery
3. Embrid
4. Embrilliance

How to get something digitized for embroidery?

You can use online digitizing services like ZDigitizing. Simply upload your design, provide your
requirements, and receive the file.

How much does it cost to digitize embroidery designs?

The cost of digitizing depends on various factors like your design size, design complexity, color
changes, and whether you need urgent delivery. So, the cost may vary from $10 to $40. 

When will I get my embroidery digitized file back?

From ZDigitizing, you’ll get your design back within few hours (4-12 hours). But if you need urgent
design, you’ll get it in 1 to 4 hours. Remember, a complex design may take time.

What file type do I need to submit for digitizing?

You can submit in any form, such as PNG, JPG, PDF, or TIFF. Just ensure that the design is clear and
of high quality, so we can ensure the best results.

It is with profound sadness that we share the passing of Robert (Bob) Mattina.

Bob dedicated his life to our family business, founded in 1955, and led it with integrity, vision,
and an unwavering commitment to helping others since 1977. Over nearly five decades of leadership,
he helped grow the company while building enduring relationships with customers, suppliers,
colleagues, and industry partners across the United States and around the world. To Bob, business
was never just about transactions—it was about people. Many of those professional relationships
became lifelong friendships.

Today, as a proud fourth-generation family business, we recognize that the foundation Bob
strengthened will continue for generations to come. Our company has always reflected the values he
lived every day: honesty, hard work, innovation, exceptional service, and genuine care for others.
His passion for the embroidery industry, depth of knowledge, and willingness to share his experience
left a lasting impression on countless people fortunate enough to know and work with him.

For our family, Bob was far more than the leader of our business. He was a devoted husband, father,
grandfather, mentor, and friend. His guidance, generosity, remarkable work ethic, and quiet humility
shaped our family and our company in ways that will continue for generations.

We are deeply grateful for the overwhelming support, prayers, and kindness shown to our family. Your
messages, calls, and words of encouragement have meant more to us than we can adequately express.

While we mourn this tremendous loss, we also celebrate an extraordinary life devoted to family,
friendship, and serving others. We remain committed to carrying forward the values Bob instilled in
our company and to honoring the relationships he treasured so deeply.

Thank you for being part of Bob’s journey and for the friendship and support you have shown our
family throughout the years. We sincerely appreciate your continued support as we honor his legacy
and continue the work he loved.

With heartfelt gratitude,

The Mattina Family.

## The Best Machine in the World. Period.

### [ About Us ][243]

ZSK Machines, a division of Notcina, is your contact for ZSK equipment and any embroidery needs.
Notcina is one of the oldest and most respected entities in the industry, started in 1955 by the
same family who operates the company today.

### [ ZSK Machines ][244]

ZSK Stickmaschinen GmbH – a German company with high standards – has become the market leader in a
highly competitive industry. Each embroidery machine must pass rigorous standards in production,
which provides superior quality & longevity.

### [ Location ][245]

Centrally located in the United States, right in the Heartland of America – St. Louis, MO. We travel
and exhibit at many of the industry trade shows – Imprinted Sportswear Shows, Embroidery Mart,
Decorated Apparel Expo and more.

### [ Why ZSK ][246]

Training, Support, and Service – it is the heart of our business. From live one-on-one computer
online training (ie: Skype, Facetime, GoToMeeting, etc.) to our advanced 4 day in-house training,
our dedication to your success is number 1.

## Versatile | Adaptable | Forward Engineering

It is with profound sadness that we share the passing of Robert (Bob) Mattina.

Bob dedicated his life to our family business, founded in 1955, and led it with integrity, vision,
and an unwavering commitment to helping others since 1977. Over nearly five decades of leadership,
he helped grow the company while building enduring relationships with customers, suppliers,
colleagues, and industry partners across the United States and around the world. To Bob, business
was never just about transactions—it was about people. Many of those professional relationships
became lifelong friendships.

Today, as a proud fourth-generation family business, we recognize that the foundation Bob
strengthened will continue for generations to come. Our company has always reflected the values he
lived every day: honesty, hard work, innovation, exceptional service, and genuine care for others.
His passion for the embroidery industry, depth of knowledge, and willingness to share his experience
left a lasting impression on countless people fortunate enough to know and work with him.

For our family, Bob was far more than the leader of our business. He was a devoted husband, father,
grandfather, mentor, and friend. His guidance, generosity, remarkable work ethic, and quiet humility
shaped our family and our company in ways that will continue for generations.

We are deeply grateful for the overwhelming support, prayers, and kindness shown to our family. Your
messages, calls, and words of encouragement have meant more to us than we can adequately express.

While we mourn this tremendous loss, we also celebrate an extraordinary life devoted to family,
friendship, and serving others. We remain committed to carrying forward the values Bob instilled in
our company and to honoring the relationships he treasured so deeply.

Thank you for being part of Bob’s journey and for the friendship and support you have shown our
family throughout the years. We sincerely appreciate your continued support as we honor his legacy
and continue the work he loved.

With heartfelt gratitude,

The Mattina Family.

### [ About Us ][243]

ZSK Machines, a division of Notcina, is your contact for ZSK equipment and any embroidery needs.
Notcina is one of the oldest and most respected entities in the industry, started in 1955 by the
same family who operates the company today.

### [ ZSK Machines ][244]

ZSK Stickmaschinen GmbH – a German company with high standards – has become the market leader in a
highly competitive industry. Each embroidery machine must pass rigorous standards in production,
which provides superior quality & longevity.

### [ Location ][245]

Centrally located in the United States, right in the Heartland of America – St. Louis, MO. We travel
and exhibit at many of the industry trade shows – Imprinted Sportswear Shows, Embroidery Mart,
Decorated Apparel Expo and more.

### [ Why ZSK ][246]

Training, Support, and Service – it is the heart of our business. From live one-on-one computer
online training (ie: Skype, Facetime, GoToMeeting, etc.) to our advanced 4 day in-house training,
our dedication to your success is number 1.
